mapper.sql: id, family_member_id, report_year, checkup_date, hospital, title, summary, file_id, remark, interpretation, interpreted_at, deleted, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO health_report (family_member_id, report_year, checkup_date, hospital, title, summary, file_id, remark) VALUES (#{familyMemberId}, #{reportYear}, #{checkupDate}, #{hospital}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{fileId}, #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM health_report WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE health_report SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE health_report SET interpretation = #{interpretation}, interpreted_at = #{interpretedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
